title: Every Time Someone Tells Me To Hurry Up, I Get Faster ⚡
music_credit: Lurking Behind - The Fly Guy Five (royalty free)
lines: Every time someone tells me to hurry up, I get faster. And everyone tells me to hurry up.
I was buckled in the car before she even found her keys.
Grandpa just tapped his watch. Nothing happened. Tapping your watch doesn't count.
Hurry up and finish your test.
I finished it before she handed it out.
I ran circles around him until he got dizzy and fell in the trash.
Then Grandma moved in. She says the same thing to everything.
Now I'm the slowest kid in town. A snail just passed me.
Comment hurry up if you want me fast again.
